question: The weather service measured wind force 7 at the address when roof tiles fell onto the garden furniture. Does storm cover apply?
answer: Storm cover requires wind force of at least 8 on the Beaufort scale. Wind force 7 is not considered storm damage, so the policy would not cover damage from roof tiles falling due to wind force 7. Storm cover applies only from wind force 8 or if nearby buildings are damaged by the wind at the location [KB-HR-AVB#storm-and-hail].

question: When do we waive the underinsurance deduction on a home contents claim?
answer: For Hausrat Comfort home contents insurance, Contoso waives the underinsurance deduction if the sum insured is at least 650 EUR per square metre of living area at the time of the loss. If this threshold is not met, the payout is reduced proportionally to the sum insured versus the actual value of the contents [KB-HR-AVB#underinsurance-waiver].

question: A basement was flooded after heavy rain. Is that covered, and is there a deductible?
answer: Flooding of a basement due to heavy rain is covered only if the policy includes the natural hazards add-on (Elementarschaden-Baustein) to the Hausrat insurance. This add-on covers damages from flooding including heavy rain (Starkregen). There is a deductible (Selbstbehalt) of 500 EUR per claim. Coverage starts after a waiting period of one month from the start of the add-on. Without this add-on, flooding from rain is not covered under the standard Hausrat Comfort policy (home contents insurance) [KB-ELEMENTAR-DE#versicherte-gefahren, KB-ELEMENTAR-DE#selbstbehalt-und-wartezeit, KB-HR-AVB#insured-perils].

Any request to change bank details requires confirmation by a callback to the phone number on file and written confirmation from the policyholder. You must not update the IBAN or pay based on an e-mail alone [KB-PROP-GUIDE#payout-and-bank-details].

question: Repair costs are 125% of the car's replacement value. Can the customer still have it repaired at our expense?
answer: If repair costs are 125% of the car's replacement value, the customer can still have it repaired at Contoso's expense. This is allowed as long as the repair costs do not exceed 130% of the replacement value, the repair is done professionally as per the expert report, and the owner uses the vehicle for at least six months afterwards. Above 130%, Contoso pays the replacement value minus the residual value instead [KB-MOTOR-GUIDE#repair-or-total-loss-130-percent-rule].

question: When should a burglary claim be referred to SIU?
answer: Refer a burglary claim to the Special Investigations Unit (SIU) when 3 or more red flags are present. Red flags include no signs of forced entry, sum insured increased within the last 6 months, claim within 90 days of policy start, high-value items without receipts, inconsistent police report, and previous similar claims. Do not inform the policyholder about the referral. A fraud score above 70 also triggers an SIU investigation. The policyholder must report the burglary to the police promptly and provide a police report reference number for settlement.
